items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: The interviewer mentions Albert Glenny worked with Chris and Rene, but the interviewee does not respond or confirm any personal interaction or relationship with Glenny.

ctx.x: When you played with Chris or heard him play, who else was in the band, can you remember? Ooh. Anybody else at all? I know you had all of them, but some of them maybe.

One of, how do you call it? Even old Glenny had worked with him off and on too. Oh, Albert Glenny. He's worked with him and Rene too, worked with both of the bands off and on, you know. That's what they used to do. Alternate in other words, you know. And one had more work than the other, well they'd work with him and the fellow had the most work, they'd work with them. That's where they used to go at the time.
Who was the highest note man around here at that time?
